1.title: Death of Cindy Crawford's son Presley Gerber being investigated as suspected overdose
1.summary: His family asked for privacy during a "very difficult and painful time" following the model's death.

2.title: East Coast Flights Disrupted Due to Communication Failures
2.summary: The incident revived concerns about the Federal Aviation Administration’s aging air traffic control infrastructure.

3.title: Why Is the Coast Guard Operating Surveillance Drones in the Great Lakes?
3.summary: Since May, the Coast Guard has deployed six surveillance drones across the Great Lakes to stop the flow of drugs and illegal border crossings from Canada. But there is little illegal activity on the northern border, and the sailing drones are raising privacy concerns.

4.title: Russia’s Election Was Engineered to Send a Message: Putin Remains in Control
4.summary: A parliamentary vote demonstrated that President Vladimir V. Putin’s autocratic system was still able to deliver the results he wanted, analysts said.

5.title: First UK charges brought over 1994 Rwanda genocide
5.summary: Dr Vincent Brown, formerly Dr Vincent Bajinya, 65, will appear at Westminster Magistrates’ Court on Tuesday charged with seven offences.

6.title: Police Officer Injured in Shooting Near Ontario Synagogue on Yom Kippur
6.summary: A gunman opened fire near the Sons of Jacob Synagogue in Belleville as congregants gathered for Yom Kippur, the authorities said.
